promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The weather is bad today”?
questions.explain: “Hace mal tiempo” = the weather is bad (“buen tiempo” would be good weather).

questions.q: What does “la playa” mean?
questions.explain: “La playa” means “the beach”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I have to change trains in Madrid”?
options: Tengo que perder el tren en Madrid
Tengo que hacer transbordo en Madrid
Tengo que cambiar dinero en Madrid
Tengo que coger el tren a Madrid
questions.explain: “Hacer transbordo” means “to change (trains/buses)”, so the first option is correct.

questions.q: Which means “My bedroom is on the first floor”?
options: Mi cocina está en el primer piso
Mi dormitorio es en el primer piso
Mi dormitorio está en el primer piso
Mi dormitorio está en la planta baja
questions.explain: “El primer piso” = the first floor and location uses “estar”.

questions.q: How do you say “I live on the third floor”?
options: Vivo en la tercera planta baja
questions.explain: “Tercer” shortens before a masculine noun, so “el tercer piso” = “the third floor”.

questions.q: What does “veranear” mean?
questions.explain: “Veranear” means “to spend the summer holidays” (from “verano”, summer).

questions.q: What does “la sequía” mean?
questions.explain: “La sequía” means “drought”, a long period without rain.

questions.q: What does 'ahorrar energía' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ahorrar' means 'to save', so 'ahorrar energía' = 'to save energy'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'If we recycled more, we would help the planet'?
options: Si reciclaremos más, ayudaríamos al planeta
Si recicláramos más, ayudaríamos al planeta
Si reciclamos más, ayudamos al planeta
Si reciclábamos más, ayudaremos al planeta
questions.explain: An unreal condition uses imperfect subjunctive + conditional: 'recicláramos... ayudaríamos'.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I live in a flat in the city centre”?
options: Vivo en una casa en el campo
Vivo en un piso en el centro de la ciudad
Vivo en un piso en las afueras
Vives en un piso en el centro de la ciudad
questions.explain: “Un piso” = a flat and “el centro de la ciudad” = the city centre.

questions.q: How do you say “We must protect the planet”?
questions.explain: “Proteger” = to protect and “el planeta” is masculine: “Hay que proteger el planeta”.

questions.q: How do you say “There isn't much to do in my village”?
options: Hay mucho que hacer en mi pueblo
No hay mucho que hago en mi pueblo
No hay mucho que hacer en mi pueblo
No hay nada de hacer en mi ciudad
questions.explain: “No hay mucho que hacer” = “there isn't much to do” and “mi pueblo” = “my village”.

questions.q: How do you say “We stayed in a campsite by the sea”?
options: Nos alojamos en un camping junto al mar
Nos alojamos en un camping junto a la montaña
Os alojasteis en un camping junto al mar
Nos alojamos en un hotel junto al mar
questions.explain: “Nos alojamos” = “we stayed”, “un camping” = campsite and “junto al mar” = by the sea.

questions.q: What does “marearse” mean when travelling?
questions.explain: “Marearse” means “to feel sick/dizzy”, e.g. travel sickness.

questions.q: What does “la carnicería” mean?
questions.explain: “La carnicería” (from “carne”, meat) means “the butcher's shop”.

questions.q: How do you say “Pollution harms the planet”?
questions.explain: “Dañar” = to harm and “el planeta” is masculine.

questions.q: What does “la contaminación” mean?
questions.explain: “La contaminación” means “pollution”.

questions.q: What does 'el billete de ida y vuelta' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ida y vuelta' means 'there and back', so 'el billete de ida y vuelta' = 'a return ticket'.

questions.q: What does “los residuos” mean?
questions.explain: “Los residuos” means “waste/rubbish”, e.g. household or industrial waste.

questions.q: What does “el medio ambiente” mean?
questions.explain: “El medio ambiente” means “the environment”.

questions.q: What does “el calentamiento global” mean?
questions.explain: “El calentamiento global” means “global warming”.

questions.q: What does “el jardín” mean?
questions.explain: “El jardín” means “the garden”.
